verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships an official CLI (pypi pipecat-ai[cli]). It has documented reference pages and covers init scaffolding, cloud deploy, evals, and context-hub. It is AI-native: `pipecat init` writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and `context-hub install` registers an MCP server with your coding agent. A runtime probe confirmed `pipecat --help` runs keylessly. missing for 10: independent community/hands-on corroboration of AI-native CLI workflows beyond vendor docs and probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the official Pipecat CLI (pypi pipecat-ai[cli]) ran keylessly via uvx — `pipecat --help` lists init (project scaffolding), cloud (deploy to Pipecat Cloud), eval (behavioral evals), and context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents).
Install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold the quickstart project (also writes AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)
pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
